decisions.briefing: Markets were flat to slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.4%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy — waiting for a genuine risk-on setup with multi-signal confirmation before deploying into new positions.

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was largely directionless, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 slipping about 0.4%. No major catalyst drove the move — it reflects a quiet, consolidating market rather than a shift in sentiment. With no strong momentum signal, staying patient and holding existing positions was the more prudent choice than chasing a marginal setup.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡,納指及標普500指數均微跌約0.4%,市場缺乏明顯催化劑,屬於一個整固性質的交易日,而非情緒轉向的訊號。在缺乏強勁動能訊號的情況下,維持現有持倉、按兵不動,較勉強追入新倉更為穩健。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sometimes the best trading decision is no decision. When cash reserves are limited and the market shows no strong directional signal, holding cash and waiting avoids buying into weak setups just to feel productive. Discipline in avoiding low-conviction trades protects capital for genuine opportunities.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 有時候最好的交易決定就是不作決定。當現金儲備有限、市場又缺乏明確方向時,持有現金並耐心等待,可避免為求「有做嘢」而勉強買入質素不佳的機會。避免低把握度交易的紀律,正是為真正的機會保留彈藥。
